# ROB-008: Deeply nested or invalid-Unicode requests are answered or rejected, never dropped

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#messages](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#messages) |

Sends a tools/list request with a value nested 512 deep, then one with a lone surrogate escape (\ud800), each under a vendor-prefixed _meta key (com.mcpprobe/hostile) that servers must not interpret (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#meta). All messages MUST follow JSON-RPC 2.0, which requires a response to every request; a server whose JSON parser refuses such a message should answer with an error (-32700 or -32600), not drop it. Any result or JSON-RPC error passes, as does an HTTP 4xx. FUZZ does not generate these inputs, so a parser that drops them is reported once per server, not once per tool. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain ROB-008`. To leave it out of a run, add `"ROB-008"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
